basic_details.job_title: NLUD Litigation Supervisor Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The NLUD Justice for Children Litigation Fellowship (Rajasthan), run under the NLUD Chair on Justice for Children with UNICEF, has called for applications for 1 Litigation Supervisor in Jaipur. The post is contractual and part-time for 12 months starting 15 December 2026, with a stipend of INR 60,000/- monthly. Applicants need an LL.B. or B.A.LL.B. and 2+ years of litigation experience in Rajasthan. Applications are made through the online form at careers.nludelhi.ac.in by 30 November 2026.

how_to_apply: Access the application form at the NLUD careers portal, careers.nludelhi.ac.in.
Submit the application through that form by 30 November 2026.
Do not send any application materials by post or email, as the notice states.
The notice does not list documents to attach. Queries can be sent to [email protected].

content_sections.heading: NLUD LITIGATION SUPERVISOR at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the age limit or the application fee.

rows.details: NLUD Justice for Children Litigation Fellowship (Rajasthan), under the aegis of the NLUD Chair on Justice for Children

content_sections.heading: About the Fellowship
content_sections.text: The NLUD Justice for Children Litigation Fellowship is described in the notice as a flagship programme for young graduates committed to litigation practice on issues under the POCSO and JJ Act. Supported by UNICEF, it aims to improve access to justice for children in need of care and protection and children in conflict with the law. It does so through quality legal aid support and by creating a cadre of well-trained, child-sensitive lawyers.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Litigation work experience of 2+ years in Rajasthan Updated knowledge of the POCSO and JJ Act, the new criminal codes and special legislations, with proficiency in court procedures and practice Strong understanding of child-centric criminal jurisprudence and child rights frameworks Experience in legal research, drafting and preparation of court pleadings Ability to supervise litigation work, including coordination with fellows on the field Experience in mentoring or training junior legal professionals High proficiency in written and spoken English and Hindi Strong organisational, coordination and case-management skills Commitment to ethical, trauma-informed and rights-based legal practice Previous work experience in child-centric cases before various child-centric forums Experience as support person Providing free legal aid, including assistance with victim compensation Proficiency in the use of MS Excel, AI tools and graphic design tools Proficiency in social media outreach

content_sections.heading: NLUD LITIGATION SUPERVISOR Job Description
content_sections.text: Oversee and coordinate all litigation-related work under the Litigation Fellowship (Rajasthan) Supervise and mentor Litigation Fellows engaged in case work Ensure effective implementation of child-centric litigation strategies in line with the new criminal laws, POCSO and JJ Act Collaborate with legal institutions and relevant platforms, including identifying and curating resource persons for project-related events Be resident in Jaipur and coordinate with the UNICEF Rajasthan Office and Rajasthan State Legal Services Authority Make routine visits to Udaipur as part of litigation supervision and case management Assign and monitor case progress and maintain litigation records and documentation Facilitate training and capacity-building of fellows in court procedures and trauma-informed child rights legal practice Act as a liaison between the litigation team and the NLUD J4C Chair Ensure adherence to professional standards, timelines and project objective

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NLUD LITIGATION SUPERVISOR
content_sections.text: Access the application form at the NLUD careers portal, careers.nludelhi.ac.in. Submit the application through that form by 30 November 2026. Do not send any application materials by post or email, as the notice states. The notice does not list documents to attach. Queries can be sent to [email protected] .

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted and will advance to the interview stage of the selection process. The notice does not give an interview date, mode or venue.

faq.question: Q1. How many Litigation Supervisor posts are there in the NLUD fellowship?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Litigation Supervisor, based in Jaipur, Rajasthan.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
Q3. What qualification is required?
faq.answer: A Law Graduate (LL.B. or B.A.LL.B.) with litigation work experience of 2+ years in Rajasthan.

faq.question: Q4. What is the stipend for the Litigation Supervisor?
Q5. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Use the application form at careers.nludelhi.ac.in. The notice asks applicants not to submit any application materials by post or email.

faq.question: Q6. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: Only shortlisted candidates are contacted and advance to the interview stage of the selection process.

faq.question: Q7. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The employment type is contractual and part-time, for 12 months starting 15 December 2026.

faq.question: Q8. Must the Litigation Supervisor live in Jaipur?
faq.answer: Yes. The responsibilities include being resident in Jaipur and making routine visits to Udaipur.

faq.question: Q9. Which languages must applicants know?
faq.answer: The essential requirements include high proficiency in written and spoken English and Hindi.
